results.title: From ambition to evidence: a practical tool for startup impact assessment | Small Business Economics | Springer Nature Link
results.content: Impact-driven startups face major challenges in measuring and reporting their social and environmental impacts. In a related manner, impact investors face challenges when attempting to assess the impact of startups. This is primarily due to a lack of comparability and transparency. Resource constraints have a significant impact on the capacity of startups to engage in complex impact measurement. The present study proposes a design science research approach to derive design knowledge for the impact assessment of startups and subsequently develop a new tool tailored to the needs of startups. The purpose of this tool is to enable startups to measure and report their potential impact efficiently. Impact-driven startups encounter difficulties in measuring their impact due to resource constraints and the complexity of available tools. This study explores how impact-driven startups currently measure their social and environmental impacts, and the challenges they face in doing so due to the complexity and resource intensity of existing tools.
